chunks: That was that, but remember God will make the plots of the unbelievers contemptible.
ai.seo_question: How does God deal with the plots of the disbelievers?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Anfal, this verse follows the description of the confusion caused by Satan to the believers at Badr, serving as a divine counterbalance where Allah actively dismantles the strategic coherence of the disbelievers. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi in *Majma' al-Bayan*, emphasize that 'weakening their plot' (muhinu kaydahum) refers to the internal discord and loss of unity that rendered their numerical advantage ineffective, illustrating the principle that divine support relies on spiritual cohesion rather than mere force.
